title: Penalty for subsequent contravention of false or misleading advertisement
description: Penalty for subsequent contravention of false or misleading advertisement by manufacturer or endorser

content.offence: Subsequent contravention of publishing false or misleading advertisement
content.applicable_section: Provided that the Central Authority may, for every subsequent contravention by a manufacturer or endorser, impose a penalty, which may extend to fifty lakh rupees
